sec-head.h2: What is ML demand forecasting for retail?

p: Machine learning demand forecasting for retail is an AI system that combines time-series models with store-level transaction data, weather, and promotional calendars to predict unit demand at the individual SKU and location level. By grounding every forecast in historical sell-through rates and real-time inventory feeds, it eliminates guesswork, reduces stockout penalties by up to 35%, and automates replenishment decisions with measurable ROI.
